Approach:
- Keep an array `stack` for elements and an array `add` of same size (or maxSize) for pending increments.

```javascript
var maximumBinaryString = function(binary) {
    const n = binary.length;
    let first = -1, zeros = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (binary[i] === '0') {
            if (first === -1) first = i;
            zeros++;
        }
    }
    if (zeros === 0) return binary;
    const arr = new Array(n).fill('1');
    arr[first + zeros - 1] = '0';
    return arr.join('');
};
```

```javascript
var maxEqualFreq = function(nums) {
    const count = new Map(); // value -> frequency
    const freq = new Map(); // frequency -> number of values with that frequency
    let maxFreq = 0;
    let ans = 0;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < nums.length; i++) {
        const x = nums[i];
        const c = count.get(x) || 0;
        count.set(x, c + 1);
        if (c > 0) {
            freq.set(c, freq.get(c) - 1);
            if (freq.get(c) === 0) freq.delete(c);
        }
        freq.set(c + 1, (freq.get(c + 1) || 0) + 1);
        if (c + 1 > maxFreq) maxFreq = c + 1;
        
        const n = i + 1;
        if (maxFreq === 1 ||
            freq.get(maxFreq) * maxFreq === n - 1 ||
            (freq.get(maxFreq) === 1 && (freq.get(maxFreq - 1) || 0) * (maxFreq - 1) === n - maxFreq)) {
            ans = n;
        }
    }
    
    return ans;
};
```

```javascript
var maxEqualFreq = function(nums) {
    const MAX = 100001;

    }
    
    return ans;
};
```

```javascript
/**
 * @param {number[]} nums
 * @param {number} firstLen
 * @param {number} secondLen
 * @return {number}
 */
var maxSumTwoNoOverlap = function(nums, firstLen, secondLen) {
    const n = nums.length;

    // prefix[i] = sum of nums[0..i-1]
    const prefix = new Array(n + 1).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + nums[i];
    }

    // Best total when an L-length subarray lies entirely before an S-length subarray.
    const bestWithOrder = (L, S) => {
        // maxLeft[i]: best sum of an L-length subarray within nums[0..i-1]
        const maxLeft = new Array(n + 1).fill(-Infinity);
        for (let i = L; i <= n; i++) {
            maxLeft[i] = Math.max(maxLeft[i - 1], prefix[i] - prefix[i - L]);
        }
        // maxRight[i]: best sum of an S-length subarray within nums[i..n-1]
        const maxRight = new Array(n + 1).fill(-Infinity);
        for (let i = n - S; i >= 0; i--) {
            maxRight[i] = Math.max(maxRight[i + 1], prefix[i + S] - prefix[i]);
        }
        let best = -Infinity;
        for (let i = L; i <= n - S; i++) {
            best = Math.max(best, maxLeft[i] + maxRight[i]);
        }
        return best;
    };

    return Math.max(
        bestWithOrder(firstLen, secondLen),
        bestWithOrder(secondLen, firstLen)
    );
};
```

```javascript
    const n = flowers.length;
    // sort descending
    const f = [...flowers].sort((a, b) => b - a);
    // prefix sums
    const prefix = new Array(n + 1).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + f[i];
    // t = number of gardens with f[i] >= target
    let t = 0;
    while (t < n && f[t] >= target) t++;
    
    let ans = 0;
    
    // helper: cost to raise f[k..n-1] to level L
    // indices j..n-1 have f < L where j = first index >= k with f[j] < L
    // binary search j in [k, n]: smallest j such that f[j] < L (with f[n] treated as -infinity)
    
    for (let k = t; k <= n; k++) {
        // cost to complete top k
        let costK;
        if (k <= t) costK = 0;
        else costK = k * target - (prefix[k] - prefix[t]);
        // note: for k >= t, indices t..k-1 have f < target, cost each = target - f[i]
        if (costK > newFlowers) break; // preCost non-decreasing
        const rem = newFlowers - costK;
        
        if (k === n) {
            ans = Math.max(ans, n * full);
            break; // k = n is the last
        }
        
        // maximize L in [0, target-1] with cost(k, L) <= rem
        // binary search L
        let lo = 0, hi = target - 1, bestL = 0;
        // cost(k, L): let j = smallest index in [k, n] with f[j] < L (f[n] = -inf so j <= n)
        // cost = (n - j) * L - (prefix[n] - prefix[j])
        while (lo <= hi) {
            const L = (lo + hi) >> 1; // wait, need Math.floor for negatives but all non-negative
            // find j
            let jlo = k, jhi = n;
            while (jlo < jhi) {
                const mid = (jlo + jhi) >> 1;
                if (f[mid] < L) jhi = mid; else jlo = mid + 1;
            }
            const j = jlo;
            const cost = (n - j) * L - (prefix[n] - prefix[j]);
            if (cost <= rem) { bestL = L; lo = L + 1; }
            else hi = L - 1;
        }
        ans = Math.max(ans, k * full + bestL * partial);
    }
    return ans;
};
```

```javascript
    const n = flowers.length;
    const f = flowers.slice().sort((a, b) => b - a); // descending
    const prefix = new Array(n + 1).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + f[i];
    
    // t = number of gardens already complete
    let t = 0;
    while (t < n && f[t] >= target) t++;
    
    // cntGe[L] = number of gardens with f >= L, for L in [0, maxVal+1]
    let maxVal = f[0];
    const cntGe = new Array(maxVal + 2).fill(0);
    // count occurrences
    const cnt = new Array(maxVal + 2).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) cnt[f[i]]++;
    for (let v = maxVal; v >= 0; v--) cntGe[v] = cntGe[v + 1] + cnt[v];
    // cntGe[L] = first index with f[index] < L (global), since descending
    
    const totalSum = prefix[n];
    let ans = 0;
    
    for (let k = t; k <= n; k++) {
        const costK = (k - t) * target - (prefix[k] - prefix[t]);
        if (costK > newFlowers) break;
        const rem = newFlowers - costK;
        if (k === n) {
            ans = Math.max(ans, n * full);
            break;
        }
        // binary search max L in [0, target-1] with cost(k, L) <= rem
        let lo = 0, hi = target - 1, best = 0;
        while (lo <= hi) {
            const L = (lo + hi) >> 1;
            let j = cntGe[L];
            if (j < k) j = k;
            const cost = (n - j) * L - (totalSum - prefix[j]);
            if (cost <= rem) { best = L; lo = L + 1; }
            else hi = L - 1;
        }
        const beauty = k * full + best * partial;
        if (beauty > ans) ans = beauty;
    }
    return ans;
};
```

```javascript
/**
 * @param {number[]} flowers
 * @param {number} newFlowers
 * @param {number} target
 * @param {number} full
 * @param {number} partial
 * @return {number}
 */
var maximumBeauty = function(flowers, newFlowers, target, full, partial) {
    const n = flowers.length;
    const f = flowers.slice().sort((a, b) => b - a); // descending
    
    const prefix = new Array(n + 1).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + f[i];
    const totalSum = prefix[n];
    
    // number of gardens already complete (f[i] >= target)
    let t = 0;
    while (t < n && f[t] >= target) t++;
    
    // cntGe[L] = count of gardens with value >= L (for L in [0, size-1])
    const size = Math.max(f[0], target) + 2;
    const cnt = new Array(size).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) cnt[f[i]]++;
    const cntGe = new Array(size).fill(0);
    for (let v = size - 2; v >= 0; v--) cntGe[v] = cntGe[v + 1] + cnt[v];
    
    let ans = 0;
    
    for (let k = t; k <= n; k++) {
        // cost to make the top k gardens complete
        const costK = (k - t) * target - (prefix[k] - prefix[t]);
        if (costK > newFlowers) break;
        const rem = newFlowers - costK;
        
        if (k === n) {
            if (n * full > ans) ans = n * full;
            break;
        }
        
        // maximize L in [0, target-1]: cost to raise f[k..n-1] to L <= rem
        let lo = 0, hi = target - 1, best = 0;
        while (lo <= hi) {
            const L = (lo + hi) >> 1;
            let j = cntGe[L];
            if (j < k) j = k;
            const cost = (n - j) * L - (totalSum - prefix[j]);
            if (cost <= rem) {
                best = L;
                lo = L + 1;
            } else {
                hi = L - 1;
            }
        }
        
        const beauty = k * full + best * partial;
        if (beauty > ans) ans = beauty;
    }
    
    return ans;
};
```

```javascript
    const n = flowers.length;
    const f = flowers.slice().sort((a, b) => b - a);

    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) prefix[i + 1] = prefix[i] + f[i];

    const cntGe = new Array(size).fill(0);
    for (let v = size - 2; v >= 0; v--) cntGe[v] = cntGe[v + 1] + cnt[v];
    
    let ans = 0;

            }
        }

    }
    
    return ans;
};
```

    *   **Randomly** decide to swap the two substrings or to keep them in the same order. i.e., after this step, `s` may become `s = x + y` or `s = y + x`.
    *   Apply step 1 recursively on each of the two substrings `x` and `y`.

```javascript
var earliestAndLatest = function(n, firstPlayer, secondPlayer) {
    const memo = new Map();
    
    function f(n, i, j) {
        if (i > j) { const t = i; i = j; j = t; }
        if (i + j === n + 1) return [1, 1];
        if (i + j > n + 1) {
            const ni = n + 1 - j, nj = n + 1 - i;
            i = ni; j = nj;
        }
        const key = (n << 10) | (i << 5) | j;
        if (memo.has(key)) return memo.get(key);
        
        const half = n >> 1;
        const nn = half + (n & 1);
        
        let cMin, cMax;
        if (j <= half) {
            cMin = 0;
            cMax = j - i - 1;
        } else {
            const cX = Math.max(0, half - (n + 1 - j));
            const Y = n - i - j;
            const cM = (n % 2 === 1 && half + 1 < j) ? 1 : 0;
            cMin = cX + cM;
            cMax = cX + Y + cM;
        }
        
        let earliest = Infinity, latest = -Infinity;
        for (let l = 0; l < i; l++) {
            for (let c = cMin; c <= cMax; c++) {
                const res = f(nn, 1 + l, 2 + l + c);
                if (res[0] < earliest) earliest = res[0];
                if (res[1] > latest) latest = res[1];
            }
        }
        const ans = [earliest + 1, latest + 1];
        memo.set(key, ans);
        return ans;
    }
    
    return f(n, firstPlayer, secondPlayer);
};
```

```javascript
/**
 * @param {number} n
 * @param {number} firstPlayer
 * @param {number} secondPlayer
 * @return {number[]}
 */
var earliestAndLatest = function(n, firstPlayer, secondPlayer) {
    const memo = new Map();

    const dfs = (n, i, j) => {
        if (i > j) { const t = i; i = j; j = t; }
        if (i + j === n + 1) return [1, 1];
        if (i + j > n + 1) {
            const ni = n + 1 - j;
            j = n + 1 - i;
            i = ni;
        }
        const key = (n << 10) | (i << 5) | j;
        if (memo.has(key)) return memo.get(key);

        const half = n >> 1;
        const nextN = half + (n & 1);

        let cMin, cMax;
        if (j <= half) {
            cMin = 0;
            cMax = j - i - 1;
        } else {
            const cX = Math.max(0, half - (n + 1 - j));
            const freeY = n - i - j;
            const cM = (n % 2 === 1 && half + 1 < j) ? 1 : 0;
            cMin = cX + cM;
            cMax = cX + freeY + cM;
        }

        let best = Infinity, worst = -Infinity;
        for (let l = 0; l < i; l++) {
            for (let c = cMin; c <= cMax; c++) {
                const res = dfs(nextN, 1 + l, 2 + l + c);
                if (res[0] < best) best = res[0];
                if (res[1] > worst) worst = res[1];
            }
        }
        const ans = [best + 1, worst + 1];
        memo.set(key, ans);
        return ans;
    };

    return dfs(n, firstPlayer, secondPlayer);
};
```
